## Analysis process

5. Identify assumptions and explicitly label them.

11. Highlight any requirement that is ambiguous, conflicting, infeasible, or potentially risky.

Welcome page include year:"2026" and instruction "Page used for QA engineer "

content.text:
### 1. Requirement summary

The existing Hari-Agents welcome page must also show the year **2026** and the instruction **Page used for QA engineer**. This is an addition to the page that is already implemented. It does not, by itself, say to remove or rewrite the current title, greeting, or tagline.

**Facts**
- The surface is the approved static welcome page under `plans/hari-agents/` (`index.html`).
- Today that page shows document title and `h1` `Hari-Agents`, greeting `Welcome to Hari-Agents`, and tagline `A personal agent workspace.`
- The page HTML does not currently contain `2026` or `Page used for QA engineer`. Dates in the SDLC docs are not page content.
- Confirmed for this change: the page is a welcome page; it must include the year string `2026`; it must include the instruction text `Page used for QA engineer`.

**Ambiguous or risky (does not block a default)**
- The request does not say where the year or instruction sit on the page.
- The quoted instruction may include a trailing space. That space is not treated as required visible text (Assumption A-2).
- Putting `2026` into the document title would conflict with the approved title `Hari-Agents`.

### 2. Business objective

Give anyone opening the welcome page, especially a QA engineer, an on-page year and an on-page statement of what the page is for.

**Expected value:** A QA engineer can confirm, from the page itself, that this is the page used for QA and that the year context is 2026, without relying on a filename, a doc date, or an external note.

The request does not state a separate customer outcome, a release name, or a copyright notice. Those are not part of this requirement.

### 3. Scope (In scope / Out of scope)

**In scope**
- The existing Hari-Agents welcome page shows the visible year `2026` at least once.
- The same page shows the visible instruction `Page used for QA engineer` at least once, with that exact spelling and capitalization.
- Both strings are present when the page is opened, with no login, form submit, or application API call.
- Previously approved welcome behavior stays in force unless a later decision explicitly replaces it (Assumption A-1).

**Out of scope**
- Removing or replacing `Hari-Agents`, `Welcome to Hari-Agents`, or `A personal agent workspace.`
- Changing the document title away from exactly `Hari-Agents`.
- Adding a second page, a QA workflow, forms, login, analytics, or a backend.
- Repo-root `requirements.md` (`US-LOGO-1` logo/PWA draft).
- Grammar edits, copyright wording, locale, or a different year.
- Jira updates or any change outside this requirement analysis.

### 4. Actors and systems

**Actors**
- **QA engineer** — reads the year and the instruction to confirm the page under test. Implied by the instruction text; not a separate login role.
- **Workspace owner and casual visitor** — still open the same welcome page (existing actors).
- **Implementer** — changes the existing page so the new strings are visible and checks them.

**Systems and components (existing)**
- **Welcome page** — `plans/hari-agents/index.html`, presented with the existing stylesheet. This is the only product surface for this change.
- **Browser** — renders the page. No backend, database, or authenticated session.
- **Existing structure test** — `welcome-page.test.mjs` currently asserts the old main content only. It is a verification dependency, not a user-facing feature.

### 5. Functional requirements (numbered, testable)

Baseline FR-1 through FR-12 in `plans/hari-agents/requirements.md` stay as approved. New IDs continue from that list.

- **FR-13:** The welcome page shall show the year **2026** at least once as visible rendered text. The four digits shall be a year token: they must not be only part of a longer digit run (for example `20260` does not satisfy this). A comment, hidden attribute, or document-only metadata date does not satisfy this.
- **FR-14:** The welcome page shall show the instruction **Page used for QA engineer** at least once as visible rendered text. Match is case-sensitive and character-exact. A trailing space after `engineer` is not required. A reworded sentence (including a plural `engineers`) does not satisfy this.
- **FR-15:** FR-13 and FR-14 shall be true after a normal page load, with no click, form submit, or application API call.
- **FR-16 (conditional on Assumption A-1):** The page shall still show document title exactly `Hari-Agents`, exactly one `h1` whose text is `Hari-Agents`, greeting `Welcome to Hari-Agents`, and tagline `A personal agent workspace.`

Inherited constraints that remain testable if A-1 holds: no input form, no analytics, static delivery, readable text at the existing desktop and narrow viewports, and the product name still present as text. New copy is subject to those same constraints. This change does not add a second `h1`.

### 6. User stories

- **US-1:** As a QA engineer, I want the welcome page to show `2026` and `Page used for QA engineer`, so I can confirm I am on the intended QA page for that year.
- **US-2 (Assumption A-1):** As a visitor, I want the existing Hari-Agents title, greeting, and tagline to remain, so the page still introduces the product.

### 7. Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then)

- **AC-FR-13.1:** Given the welcome page is opened in a browser, when the page has finished loading, then visible text includes the year token `2026`.
- **AC-FR-13.2:** Given the page is rendered, when `2026` appears only inside an HTML comment, a non-visible attribute, or a longer digit sequence, then FR-13 is not met.
- **AC-FR-14.1:** Given the welcome page is visible, when a user reads the page, then the exact text `Page used for QA engineer` is visible.
- **AC-FR-14.2:** Given the instruction is displayed, when visible text is compared, then no trailing space after `engineer` is required.
- **AC-FR-14.3:** Given the page is visible, when the only similar sentence is a corrected variant such as `Page used for QA engineers`, then FR-14 is not met.
- **AC-FR-15.1:** Given no login session and no application API are running, when the static welcome page is opened, then both `2026` and `Page used for QA engineer` are visible without a click or form submit.
- **AC-FR-16.1 (Assumption A-1):** Given the updated welcome page is visible, when a user reads it, then the tab title is `Hari-Agents`, the only `h1` is `Hari-Agents`, `Welcome to Hari-Agents` is visible, and `A personal agent workspace.` is visible.

### 8. Assumptions

- **A-1 (preservation):** This request is additive. Approved FR-1 through FR-12 remain in force, including title, greeting, tagline, single `h1`, static delivery, no forms, and no analytics. The new request does not restate that content; it also does not conflict with it. **Recommendation:** treat removal of existing welcome copy as out of scope unless the requester explicitly overrides A-1.
- **A-2 (trailing space):** The user’s quotes may contain a trailing space after `engineer`. HTML collapses trailing whitespace in normal text. The required visible text is `Page used for QA engineer` with no required trailing space. The trailing space is not semantically required.
- **A-3 (visibility):** “Include” means a person looking at the rendered page can see each string. Source-only or comment-only text fails.
- **A-4 (placement):** Any visible placement on this same welcome page meets FR-13 and FR-14. Order relative to the greeting and tagline is not specified. **Recommendation:** keep `Hari-Agents` as the only `h1` and the document title; put the year and instruction in additional visible body text.
- **A-5 (year wording):** The requirement is the year token `2026`, not a copyright line, version label, or the doc date `2026-10-05`. Embedding `2026` in a short visible phrase is acceptable. Inventing “Copyright” is not required.
- **A-6 (cardinality):** At least one visible occurrence of each string is enough.
- **A-7 (audience):** The instruction identifies the page’s QA use. It does not create a separate QA-only build or a gated view.
- **A-8 (language):** The instruction stays exactly as written, including singular `engineer`.

### 9. Dependencies and risks

**Dependencies**
- Approved baseline in `plans/hari-agents/requirements.md` (FR-1–FR-12) and the current page content in `index.html`.
- Existing architecture constraints: plain HTML and CSS, no page JavaScript, no backend, files on this welcome page.
- `welcome-page.test.mjs` currently requires `main` to contain only the `h1`, the greeting, and the tagline. Adding the new strings inside `main` will fail that check until the check is updated to expect them. The new strings are still required on the page either way.

**Constraints**
- Document title remains exactly `Hari-Agents` if A-1 holds, so the year cannot be satisfied by changing the title to include `2026`.
- Exactly one `h1` (`Hari-Agents`) remains if A-1 holds.
- No new input, tracking, or remote content.

**Risks and edge cases**
- **Title collision:** Putting `2026` only in the tab title conflicts with approved FR-1. That solution is not acceptable under A-1.
- **False year match:** `20260` or a non-visible `2026` must not pass.
- **Copy “fix”:** Changing the instruction to `QA engineers` fails FR-14.
- **Trailing space:** A required trailing space cannot be verified reliably as visible text. A-2 removes that as a pass/fail condition.
- **First viewport:** Approved FR-5 puts the heading, greeting, and tagline on the first desktop screen. The new request does not say the year and instruction must also be on that first screen. Extra lines could push content. See Q-1.
- **Hidden text:** `display` or off-screen text that is not actually visible fails FR-13 and FR-14 even if the source contains the words.
- **Scope creep:** Treating “for QA engineer” as a request to add a test harness, ticket links, or a second page is out of scope.

### 10. Open questions

None of these block architecture if A-1 through A-8 are accepted.

- **Q-1:** Must `2026` and `Page used for QA engineer` both be visible without scrolling at about 1280×800, or is visible-after-load enough even if the user scrolls? **Default if unset:** visible after load without interaction; first-screen placement is not mandatory for the new lines.
- **Q-2:** Is a standalone `2026` required, or is a short phrase that contains the year token enough? **Default if unset:** a visible year token is enough; no copyright sentence.
- **Q-3:** Was singular `engineer` intentional? **Default if unset:** keep the exact string in FR-14.

### 11. Recommended next steps

1. Accept A-1 through A-8 and the defaults for Q-1 through Q-3, and update the welcome-page architecture so the new visible strings are part of this page while title, single `h1`, greeting, and tagline stay.
2. Update verification expectations so a pass requires `2026` and `Page used for QA engineer` and still requires the existing welcome strings. The current exact `main` assertion will not pass unchanged once those strings are added inside `main`.
3. Do not implement from this note alone until that architecture pass records the additive copy. Implementation remains a later stage.

**GATE: Yes.** Requirements are clear enough to guide architecture. **Blockers: none**, provided preservation (A-1), no required trailing space (A-2), and visible body text rather than a title change (A-4) are accepted. Q-1 through Q-3 are non-blocking.
